info.description: Init — PolyBLEP into Output (same as patches/init.json)
info.name: Init

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

octave.tooltip: Shared octave offset into Voice Frequency.

semitones.tooltip: Shared semitone offset into Voice Frequency.

cents.tooltip: Shared cents offset into Voice Frequency.

frequency.tooltip: Shared Hz offset after octave/semitone/cents (param domain).

updateOnTrigger.tooltip: On: Delay/Attack/Decay/Sustain/Release/curves/Loop/Level latch on Gate rise — knob/mod changes wait until the next trigger. Off: params apply live.

attackShape.tooltip: Bipolar segment shape. 0 = linear, + = exponential (fast→slow), − = logarithmic (slow→fast).

releaseShape.tooltip: Bipolar shape for decay and release. 0 = linear, + = exp, − = log.

seed.tooltip: Master seed for Random Phase and per-voice Random Steps jitter.

voices.tooltip: Number of PolyBLEP oscillators (max 64). Decimal like Additive: 12.5 → 13 oscillators with the last at half amplitude.

waveform.tooltip: soemdsp PolyBLEP shape for every oscillator. Pulse / Pulse Center / Trisaw use Morph as PWM.

morph.tooltip: PWM / width (0…1). 0.5 = center / 50%. Affects Trisaw, Pulse, and Pulse Center. Same bipolar rational −0.9 skew as PolyBLEP Morph (finer near center).

frequency.tooltip: Shared fundamental for every oscillator. 0 Hz is valid (frozen phase). Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency. Domain is param-owned — DSP does not floor Hz.

phase.tooltip: Global phase add on every voice (cycles). Also slides the face phase lines.

randomizePhase.tooltip: Permanent random starting phase offset per saw (after Distance). 0 = no extra random offset.

centerSide.tooltip: 0 = center voices only, 1 = side voices only. Face: additive off-red=left, off-blue=right, center=both→white.

phaseCollapse.tooltip: Where Distance 0 settles. Merge (0): all phases stack together. Distribute (1): walk collapses onto even centers (i/N).

jitterDistance.tooltip: Walk room around phase centers. 0 = collapse onto centers (Merge or Distribute). Uses normal parameter smoothing (param menu).

jitterSpeed.tooltip: Walk step rate when Distance > 0 (also pitch-tilted).

jitterSpeedRef.tooltip: Anchor pitch where Jitter Tilt is neutral (walkHz = Speed).

jitterTilt.tooltip: Pitch curve for Jitter Speed: walkHz = Speed × (f / Speed Ref)^(tilt+1). −1 = absolute Speed. 0 = same aggressiveness vs pitch (∝ f). +1 = highs modulate harder (∝ f²). Hidden by default — show via metaparam.

vibratoDistance.tooltip: Sine phase room around centers — same units as Jitter Distance. (1/N)×Distance × wavetable sine, added on the same phase bus as jitter.

vibratoSpeed.tooltip: Base vibrato LFO rate (sine, phase offset 0.5).

vibratoPhaseVary.tooltip: Per-voice vibrato LFO phase offset (Master Seed). 0 = all in phase; 1 = full random 0…1 offset.

mode.tooltip: Lin = clamp Env to 0…1. Exp = classic VCA CV law (quiet lows, unity at 1) for Amplitude params.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Trisaw, Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param row.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only — type large values for gain past unity (domain not hard-clamped).

mode.tooltip: Pattern: up, dn, up/dn, dn/up, or random over Arp Keys.

rate.tooltip: Free-run step rate when Trigger and f are unconnected. Ignored whenever f is patched (external rate in Hz). Trigger edges always win over both.

steps.tooltip: Steps before pattern restart (esp. Random). 0 = natural wrap / free-run RNG.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for Random. Reset re-seeds from this value.

octaveOffset.tooltip: Transpose arpeggiated pitch by whole octaves (−4…+4). Applied to 0.1V/Oct and ƒ outs.

sequenceOffset.tooltip: Rotate the pattern (including Random) by this many steps. Same seed, different offset → a shifted sequence.

bpm.tooltip: Tempo in beats per minute. Also writes the patch Master Clock BPM.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1 / Gate -1+1.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note (same as Ping Pong). Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3× (three fit in two normals).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level for gate and trigger outs.

interpolation.tooltip: Delay-line fractional read. Linear (default). Hidden — enable from the parameter visibility menu.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note. Numer=0 → no delay. Examples: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×.

offset.tooltip: Static trim (ms) of the tempo-base delay on both taps: delay = tempoBase + Offset + LFO_Amp×lfo. Not LFO depth — that is LFO Amp. Negative shortens, positive lengthens. Sample-accurate — pitches when swept or MOD’d.

lfoStyle.tooltip: Shape of the built-in delay-time modulator. Parabol / Random Walk / FBM.

lfoRate.tooltip: LFO speed in Hz (0…20). Speed only — depth is LFO Amp (ms). Gold LFO L/R outs move whenever Rate > 0, even if Amp is 0.

lfoAmp.tooltip: How far the LFO moves delay time (ms) around (tempoBase + Offset). Default 25 ms is audible wow; 0 = tempoBase+Offset only (Rate still drives gold LFO outs). Unlike Delay Mod (fraction of delay time), this depth is absolute milliseconds.

lfoVariation.tooltip: Detunes L vs R LFO rates so the two delays don’t lock together.

lpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole lowpass in the feedback loop (darkens repeats). 0 Hz holds (closed); DSP caps at Nyquist. Slider min/max are guides only.

hpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole highpass in the feedback loop (thins mud / DC). Slider min/max are guides only; DSP caps at Nyquist.

feedback.tooltip: Feedback into the saturated tape loop. Saturate soft-clips. >1 can self-oscillate.

saturate.tooltip: Soft clip in the feedback path (tape grunge). Lower = harder saturation; higher = cleaner.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet mix on Mix L / Mix R.

volume1.tooltip: Pair 1 level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

volume2.tooltip: Pair 2 level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

pan1.tooltip: Pair 1 stereo balance. 0 = unchanged. −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

pan2.tooltip: Pair 2 stereo balance. 0 = unchanged. −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

amplitude.tooltip: Master gain after both pairs (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Wire unipolar spawn uses 0…1.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar).

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Module default −10 (bipolar). Wire spawn uses −1 or 0 for unit CV.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Module default +10 (bipolar). Wire spawn uses +1 for unit CV; unipolar param default is 0…10.

smoothingSeconds.tooltip: Time the output takes to reach the mouse target. 0 = snap.

smoothingType.tooltip: Lin = constant-time ramp. 1P / 2P = exponential. Papoulis = 3rd-order settle.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = target the pointer set. Smoothed = actual output chasing that target.

polarity.tooltip: Legacy. Bipolar with Min at 0 maps Bias to −Max…+Max.
